description: NaBi₃(O₂I)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Amm2 space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two NaBi₃(O₂I)₂ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(1), np.int64(0)) direction. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O and four I atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.42 Å. There are two shorter (3.57 Å) and two longer (3.62 Å) Na-I bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Bi sites. In the first Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Bi-O bond lengths are 2.26 Å. In the second Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Bi-O bond lengths are 2.29 Å. In the third Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Bi-O bond lengths are 2.29 Å. O is bonded to one Na and three Bi atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaBi₃ tetrahedra. There are two inequivalent I sites. In the first I site, I is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na atoms. In the second I site, I is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na atoms.
